jobDescription:
Salesforce Administrator

Location: Paris, France / Hybrid
Employment: Full-time

About the Role
We run our sales and service operations on Salesforce and need a Salesforce Administrator to own the platform day to day.

Key Responsibilities
- Administer and configure Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
- Manage users, roles, profiles, and permission sets.
- Build reports, dashboards, flows, and validation rules.
- Maintain data quality and run imports.
- Gather requirements from sales and support teams and translate them into configuration.

Required Skills
- 3+ years as a Salesforce Administrator
- Sales Cloud and Service Cloud configuration
- Flow Builder and declarative automation
- Reports and dashboards
- User and security management (roles, profiles, permission sets)
- Data management and imports

Required Certifications
- Salesforce Certified Administrator

Nice to Have
- Salesforce Advanced Administrator
- Apex / basic development
- French and English
resume:
Chloé Martin — Salesforce Administrator, Paris.

4 years administering Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Salesforce Certified Administrator. Build flows, reports, and dashboards; manage users, profiles, and permission sets. French (native), English (fluent).
